breaking.change: og style check reports contrast as facts about what is drawn instead of root-token ratios: the core-control sheet's pages and every built-in document (from its fixture:default) are built under the pack in both schemes without a GPU, and each text is read on what is drawn under it (fills, gradients and images where the text is, glass, layer opacity; a ground the UI covers only partly over black and over white, called scene), with its WCAG 2 ratio, APCA Lc and, with a text-shadow or stroke, its ratio on that halo, read a pixel out from the glyphs' edge on their weakest side as the renderer covers it (a blurred shadow covers at most half there; an offset one, one side only). It also reports how far apart (ΔEOK) the team and state colours stay under protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia. It takes a pack by name (fantasy) or default for the core style. Nothing is graded; the bars are in the screens guide's §5. The --json report's rootTokenContrast is gone; contrast and colorVision replace it.
breaking.fix: Read --json's contrast (sheet, scheme, text, path, ink, ground, over, disabled, halo, ratio, apca per text) and colorVision (scheme, set, vision, pairs with deltaE) where a script read rootTokenContrast.
